purpose: Preregister the leading geological Stage-2 candidate, define a spatially blocked promotion rule, and preserve its outcome without changing the rule after scoring.
target_limit: Local labels are byte-identical to the existing-known-fault raster. These holdouts assess known-fault recovery only and cannot validate truly unmapped-fault detection or predict an organizer score.

holdout_protocol.design: 3x3 contiguous spatial blocks; 1.2 km boundary band removed from training; score within held-out blocks only
holdout_protocol.mass_ratio: M/|G|=3.47 using each fold's observed held-out truth mass

additional_gates: Stage 1 remains a weak broad-tile prior and does not dominate fine-scale placement
official local GeoTIFF format verification passes
support uniqueness passes against all available local prior artifacts
no competition slot is spent unless all gates pass

leading_candidate.name: Cross-physics magnetic/gravity edge-normal concordance
leading_candidate.physical_signature: At matched 200 m and 500 m scales, normalize edge strength and compare magnetic/gravity edge-normal orientation; retain coincident, similarly oriented edges.
leading_candidate.rationale: Magnetic susceptibility and density contrasts may persist under cover. This is a geological mechanism hypothesis, not evidence of hidden-fault performance.
leading_candidate.novelty: Existing features include single-field lineament transforms and H-E multi-physics coincidence; no tested feature combined magnetic/gravity edge-normal orientation at matched scales.
leading_candidate.expected_benefit: Qualitative moderate but uncertain upside; no numerical forecast preregistered.
leading_candidate.external_data_needs: No new download; hash-pinned competition feature layers. Hidden expert labels remain unavailable locally.

outcome.decision: Not eligible for submission build or slot.
outcome.implementation_note: The frozen layer-family plan listed RTP, TMI horizontal/vertical derivatives, and gravity horizontal/vertical derivatives. The measured builder used only rank-normalized comp_tmi and comp_iso_grav_anom as inputs to the new transform at 200 m and 500 m scales. The derivative bands remained in the common baseline stack but were not inputs to the new transform. This is a partial/narrow test and does not falsify every version of the broader hypothesis.

separate_stage1_result.role: weak broad-tile prior only; not a fine-scale locator or hard gate
separate_stage1_result.randomized_dti_mass_assumption: The stage-1-only randomized DTI control uses provisional g_hidden=12,700; this is inherited local working value, not an organizer count. It does not alter the rank-correlation/lift analysis.

decision: No new GeoTIFF was written. The separate H-D soft-w=0.20 proposal passed the numeric screen but failed uniqueness (support Jaccard 0.861297; containment 0.925480); do not rerun it unchanged. No submission slot was used.
